title: Rate of a Chemical Reaction and Factors Affecting it
intro: Rate = how fast a reactant disappears or a product appears — change in concentration (or volume of gas, or mass) per time.

body: The phrase “rate of reaction” means how fast the reaction is occurring or the speed of the reaction.

cards.title: 1.2.1 Chemical Equilibrium and Its Characteristics
body: A chemical reaction may be either reversible or irreversible.
A reversible reaction is one in which the reactants can form the products, and the products can also form the reactants under the conditions of the reaction.
